description: Eight vessel source files embed a RAW NUL byte as a composite-key separator inside template literals, which makes GNU grep classify them as binary and SUPPRESS EVERY LINE MATCH. MEASURED 2026-09-14: repos/activity-api/src/routes/execution-traces.ts is 254,962 bytes with 2 NUL bytes at lines 4372 and 4600; 'grep -c trace_digest' on it prints NOTHING AT ALL (not 0), while 'rg -c' returns 7. CONSEQUENCE, ALREADY OBSERVED: that file owns the trace_digest write path (INSERT INTO trace_digest near line 594) feeding 2,604 live rows read by exemplar-selector, learning-track-classifier, index.ts and trace-retention. A grep-based search for that writer finds nothing and attributes the write to the nearest plausible file - which is precisely how the open gap compose-digests-are-written-without-the-fields-a-reader-would-need acquired the wrong edit_site repos/activity-api/src/routes/activities.ts, a file containing zero digest writes. Right observation, wrong file, lane burns attempts on an anchor that is not there. THE 15 SITES: activity-api execution-traces.ts:4372,4600; impulses.ts:5273,5287; lib/cluster-posterior.ts:227; lib/posterior-aggregator.ts:149,245; development-vessel dead-end-decision-scan.ts:259; operator-review-patch.ts:130; schema-assert-drift-scan.ts:234; deployment/vessels/minibob/impulse-cooccurrence.ts:160. THE FIX IS ESCAPE-SUBSTITUTION ONLY: replace the raw NUL byte with the two-character escape sequence backslash-x-0-0. Identical runtime string, provable no-op, file becomes text. DO NOT SUBSTITUTE A DIFFERENT SEPARATOR such as pipe or double-colon: the value is a live Map/cache key and at operator-review-patch.ts:130 it is INPUT TO A SHA256 DIGEST, so any other separator silently changes every stored digest. NOTE ON LANDABILITY: the whole effect of this change lies inside a string literal, so stripCommentsAndStrings sees no delta and both compose gates refuse it as zero_behaviour_delta. Do not pad it past the gate. This gap is blocked on the same string-only exemption decision as the operator-facing-prose class. REOPENED 2026-09-14: THE BLOCKER IS GONE. This was rejected as not-currently-landable because its entire effect is inside a string literal and the zero-behaviour-delta gate refused that shape. That exemption is now LANDED (commit ede0030, on origin/dev): patch-with-tools.ts refuses only when a comments-preserved comparison ALSO matches, so a string-literal delta passes while comment- and whitespace-only changes are still refused. Verified: tsc exit 0, the existing 12-case gate suite green, and 9 behavioural cases including block-comment-only and comment-edit-only still refusing. THE FIX IS NOW LANDABLE THROUGH THE LANE. Replace each RAW NUL byte with the two-character escape sequence backslash-x-0-0 - identical runtime string, provable no-op, and the file becomes readable to grep. DO NOT substitute a different separator such as pipe or double-colon: the value is a live Map/cache key and at operator-review-patch.ts:130 it is INPUT TO A SHA256 DIGEST, so any other separator silently changes every stored digest.
